title: Chapter 875
paragraphs: Chapter 875
Episode 218. Structure where stronger ones come after you knock down one (4)
Meri and the Tona brothers were not the only ones facing the newly formed grand rift.
Schucheron Kingdom, Oken Desert.
Here, Tuben, Heijin, and the family's executioners were dealing with two commanders and almost fifty thousand demon soldiers who had come out of the grand rift.
"I didn't expect to face such a fierce battlefield so soon after the Black Sea. Indeed, the family head did not bring us back for nothing."
"It's a blow to my pride to ask for support."
The new grand rift formed as soon as Tuben, Heijin and the group eliminated about half of the forces from the existing grand rift.
As soon as they killed one commander and about twenty thousand demons, thus gaining a clear upper hand, the sky turned purple, and the shockwave of the grand rift spread.
"Who do you think is coming, Tuben?"
"Well... the third group, maybe? I heard from the communication a while ago that the first group seems a bit exhausted. They killed a commander in a few minutes, so it's inevitable."
Runtia also used siblinghood to remove the grand rift in the first mission area, but naturally, she was relatively less tired than Luna.
"I have a feeling someone more familiar and welcome will come."
At the moment Heijin said that, two commanders of the demonic world showed their figures from the newly formed grand rift.
They stood next to the remaining commander and looked at the battlefield.
"Huh, Ragar is dead?"
"Did these humans kill him? Hanalrope."
The two commanders who just escaped from the rift, Vargo Kalagawa and Rimdon Groshea, spoke.
They were each kin to Fleck Kalagawa and Sakiel Groshea, who Luna just killed.
When Hanalrope nodded, Rimdon shook his head as if he couldn't understand.
"I don't have any specific information about those two. Ah, are they the knights of Syron Runekendel, who returned a while ago?"
"Whatever their identity is, they are not to be underestimated since they killed Ragar. Don't let your guard down and face them properly."
In the meantime, the demon realm's fortress, summoned from the grand rift, began to cover the Oken Desert.
The knights of Runekendel avoided the erupting buildings and rearranged their formation.
For this battle, the demonic world deliberately stationed many demons and commanders equivalent to them in the rifts scattered in the inland.
While the sea could easily be captured without even sending commanders, it was not the case for the inland.
Especially, this place, the Oken Desert, was the area where the most commanders were deployed at the same time.
The aim of the demonic world is to establish a foothold in the inland, starting from the Oken Desert, and expand its base. After all, they have already established a maximum garrison in the sea.
"Before we cross swords, I would like to hear your names, human commanders. Tell me, how are you known in this world?"
Rimdon, the highest-ranking among the three commanders, stepped forward. The demons summoned along with the castle were already surrounding the knights.
"Black Helmet."
"Black Helmet? Well, I feel unnecessarily embarrassed asking for nothing, as we will naturally know once we capture and punish you. Attack!"
At Rimdon's command, the fifty thousand demons rushed all at once, launching sword strikes, magic, and cannons.
"Runekendel, breakthrough!"
"Understood!"
With Tuben and Heijin at the forefront, the knights roared as they formed a breakthrough formation.
The total power of Runekendel consisted of two black knights from the previous generation and five hundred execution knights.
Despite the troop difference being precisely a hundredfold, they charged without showing any signs of intimidation, as if they were about to slaughter the enemies cornered.
The demons also showed a scene of clashing without hesitation, filled with madness.

Every time Tuben and Heijin swung their swords, dozens of demons at the forefront were sliced into six pieces, and the execution knights tirelessly swung their swords at the demons rushing in from the sides and rear.
It seemed like a purple river was rushing in.
This was not just a metaphor, the flesh and blood of the Ben demons were already flowing like a river.
"Indeed, they were worth killing Ragar. Let the lower ones drain their stamina, then we'll ambush all at once."
However, Rimdon's plan could not be implemented.
[Boooong-!]
It was because a white dimensional gate opened in the sky again, and Mote showed up.
Mote had four people on board.
Sirius Endorma, Jedd Runekendel, Vanessa Olson.
And Hedo.
The three, excluding Sirius, immediately jumped to the ground and swung their swords, and the impact caused an earthquake on the entire battlefield for a moment.
Sirius immediately entered the otherworldly tundra with Mote for another area.
"Is everyone alright?"
Jedd asked, spreading a meteor shower.
The superhuman meteor he gained from breaking through the Black Sea alone continued to explode the demons like fireworks.
"Ho, as Heijin said, some more welcome people really have come."
"He brought the alley cat that used to be our delight in that barren Black Sea from time to time when I was young, friends."
Vanessa spoke.
The alley cat.
When Hedo was wandering in the Black Sea in his youth, Siron and the black knights really perceived him as such.
Fierce and annoying, but occasionally when spending time together, they could forget the desolation of the Black Sea for a moment.
"…… Look here, Vanessa, are you really going to keep calling me an alley cat?"
"Even if you've become the chief of staff of the Bamel Union, in our memories, you'll always just be a cute alley cat. That perception won't change, so don't expect it to."
"Hehe, well then."
"Oh, who is this? If it isn't the alley cat, Hedo!"
"You're still cute and welcome indeed."
Their faces, which were just ghostly a moment ago, are gone, Tuben and Heijin giggled as they looked at Hedo.
Hedo felt a little burdened being called an alley cat, but he was grateful for the moment when he finally came to help the benefactors of his youth.
If he had not met Siron and the knights in the Black Sea at that time, Hedo would have ended his life as a beast without ever ascending to India until he died.
He wouldn't have met Sandra Jiffel, who was more precious than his life.
"Tuben, Heijin. You seem tired, so you should just assist from now on."
"The alley cat is speaking human language, we should listen."
"Ah, a little."
The three people who suddenly appeared changed the atmosphere of the battlefield in one breath, and the commanders of the demonic world could not help but reveal an unpleasant look.
"But we will finish off that Hanalrof guy. You guys only take care of the two newly appeared ones."
From the perspective of the commanders, it was a dumbfounding situation, but they couldn't ignore their skills.
Jedd's meteor shower is already slaughtering thousands of demons, and the demons that rushed towards Vanessa were swept away without a trace by her sword dance.
The swordsmanship emanating from Hedo's vigor was quickly creating a path towards the commanders.
The swords that poured out like a tidal wave pounded the commanders' shields.
As the five greatest superhumans of the union gathered, the ordinary troops nearing fifty thousand in number, in fact, had no significant meaning.
Only the demon commanders, at least, could make a meaningful contribution to their battle.
As there were commanders interspersed among the troops, Jedd decided to take them on all at once.
Hanalrof was taken by Tuben and Heijin, and Bargowa and Rimdon were taken by Vanessa and Hedo, respectively.
A new battle structure was formed.
Unlike Pleg, the commanders had no intention of retreating. After all, capturing the Oken Desert was the main goal of this great war.
“We've all fought with things worse than you guys countless times in the Black Sea, risking our lives and winning. So, there's no need to feel too wronged about losing."
Back to the sea, the stronghold of the demon world.
Sakiel was watching the entire situation through the crystal ball, trying to maintain a calm expression.
‘...After Schucheron, does this mean we're pushed back even in the Oken desert? I knew there would be many variables, but I didn’t expect it to this extent.’
Jin and Murakan couldn't see the crystal ball, but they were informed of all the situations through communication devices from Kashmir.
A complete victory.
The result of the first Great War was nothing short of a complete victory. Most of the Demon World's secret weapon, 'additional dimensional rifts', had been shattered.
Not every battlefield had been won. In some parts of the Empire and Hufester, the transition of the Demon World successfully ended.
It was because it was impossible to block all the newly emerging rifts in real-time.
However, key areas were defended without fail and there were no civilian casualties, so the seized lands had to be gradually recovered through warfare.
"Well, we seem to have understood each other's situation. Sakiel, if you still have no intention of calling Paelito. I intend to make one last proposal and return."
"A proposal, you say?"
"Yes, or you could call it a last warning. The content is simple and clear. The Demon World should withdraw all rifts even now, return to your land and enjoy the same life as before."
"…You're too intoxicated by such a small victory. I reject your offer."

"Well, I just tried to say it. Even if you guys back off now, you never know when you could threaten humanity again, so for the future, you should not leave any sprouts of anxiety. But, it seems like we are quite burdensome to you?"
"What are you suddenly talking about?"

"It's strange. From your perspective, the Barmel Alliance is an enemy, and now the leader and the guardian dragon have found the enemy camp themselves. You keep telling them to just go back. If I were in the same situation, I would have tried to fight it out."
Sakiel looked at Jin with tension. Jin smiled mischievously.
"Before I go, I'll give you a gift, try to handle it well. Murakan!"
As Jin called his name, Murakan's form began to change all at once. Pumpkin-colored eyes burned like fire, and a pair of wings sprouted on his back.
This was Murakan's true form, an awakened state, confirmed through the fake and the old truth in the Seventh of Temar.
Despite Sakiel widening his eyes, he felt a strange sensation of his sight suddenly going out.
Black Dragon Ultimate Move
True Dark Arrival
In the seventh tomb of Temar, Murakan not only regained his memory. He also regained the ability to use his ultimate move that he had forgotten for a long time.
Sakiel and the demons of the garrison could only shudder as they faced a terrifying darkness as much as when there was no artificial sun underground.
